DISSOLUTION (operator-approved, 2026-08-22): this register bundled 4 unrelated pending design rulings and is dissolved into per-item tickets. Item → ticket mapping:

1. Code-review invocation/enforcement semantics (source bug afflicted-hexed-arthropods, 5b32-37c4-f99a-4315, closed) → NEW ticket `leading-timeless-meadowlark` (7da9-4139-4c7f-4db2), status `idea` (awaits a design ruling), linked discovered_from this register. The register's full decision text is captured in its description.

2. Bedrock region pinning (peach-chemic-hairstreak, adb6-4762-90f6-4e30) → already fixed under that ticket; verified CLOSED. No new ticket; the existing relates_to link on this register stands as the citation.

3. Enrich-drain architecture (escalated via unamicable-exuberant-chupacabra, 9c90-9015-78ea-4d2c, closed) → tracked by EXISTING open bug `draughty-callous-tanager` (6148-5d81-8e80-41e8), which carries the proven mechanism from the in-flight RCA of quenched-defectible-killdeer (3d57-602f-0b75-48ee). Recorded the blockage as a blocking link: 6148 depends_on 3d57 (it already carried discovered_from 3d57). Also linked this register relates_to 6148.

4. `_concurrency.py` package-context contract (source bug silt-resistant-gonolek, b0a8-5496-d178-40a9, closed) → NEW ticket `carefree-submissive-barnacle` (e5ea-12f3-177b-485a), status `idea` (awaits a design ruling), linked discovered_from this register. The register's full decision text is captured in its description.

AC disposition: AC1 and AC2 are satisfied (all four escalations listed with exact decisions; every listed source bug holds relates_to + evidence — the item-3 live vehicle 6148 was additionally linked relates_to). AC3 ("operator decisions move entries from Pending to Resolved") is superseded by this dissolution ruling and intentionally left unticked. Closing as a plain task close per operator instruction.
